description: Angular component for managing a list of entities with search, selection, and creation features in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: EntityListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing a list of entities with search and selection capabilities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the filteredEntities observable for entity search.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, notably resetting on entityType change.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a list of entity IDs to the component, fetching full entity data if necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current selection based on required status.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Emits an event to create a new entity with optional search text.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an entity to the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity from the list.

methods.name: displayEntityFn
methods.description: Returns display name for an entity.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event to update validation.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.
